turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I work nights in a hospital and I sleep during the day. My phone keeps waking me up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Set a do not disturb schedule for your sleep hours. It silences everything at once.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: But I can't miss calls from my kids' school. That's the whole problem.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can allow certain contacts through. Add the school and your partner as favourites, and only they will ring.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if a call comes from the school office instead of

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good thinking. There's often a setting that lets a call through if the same number tries twice within a few minutes. Schools usually do try again if it's urgent.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's actually perfect. Why didn't I do this years ago?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Better late than never. Sleep well today.
